item.title: The Ultimate List of Open Source Cloud-Native Tools
item.description: Discover the ultimate compilation of open-source cloud-native tools curated by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF). From scheduling and observability to security, CI/CD, service mesh, and edge computing, explore a comprehensive range of tools revolutionizing the cloud-native landscape
item.dc:creator: Bill Doerrfeld

item.title: Intel, Layer5 Announce MeshMark to Quantify Cloud-Native Performance
item.description: MeshMark, a metric introduced by Intel and Layer5, helps quantify and optimize cloud-native service mesh deployments. Part of CNCF's Service Mesh Performance project, MeshMark measures load latency and resource utilization, providing essential insights for enhancing cloud-native environments.
item.dc:creator: ITPro Today

item.title: MeshMark: the Cloud Native Value Measurement
item.description: Layer5, a provider of cloud native management software, announced today the general availability of the Meshery Docker Extension. Complementing Docker Desktop's role as the go-to Kubernetes environment for cloud native developers, the Meshery Docker Extension provides easy access to the next layer of cloud native infrastructure. As an inaugural Docker Extensions Partner and a maker of industry-defining, cloud native software, Layer5’s integration of Meshery provides a visual pathway for existing Docker Compose applications to move into Kubernetes and onto any Cloud.
item.dc:creator: The Newsroom

item.title: Google Petitions to Donate Istio Service Mesh to CNCF
item.description: Google and Istio Steering Committee submit Istio service mesh to CNCF for incubation, aiming for closer collaboration with Kubernetes. Service mesh competition focuses on feature richness and applicability to both cloud-native and legacy environments, becoming integral in DevOps workflows.
